fix_summary: Add file-based locking (fcntl.flock) to prevent race condition in next_id calculation during concurrent add operations

approach.description: Added exclusive_access() context manager using fcntl.flock to serialize read-modify-write operations when adding todos. This ensures that the load() -> next_id() -> save() sequence is atomic across processes.
cons: Lock file may persist if process crashes

risks.platform_limitation: fcntl is Unix-only; will raise AttributeError on Windows
risks.lock_contention: High concurrency may cause processes to wait for lock
risks.stale_locks: Lock files persist after release but don't block subsequent operations

validation_commands: uv run ruff check src/flywheel/cli.py src/flywheel/storage.py
